basic_info.description: This beautifully maintained top-floor Edwardian condo is filled with natural light and set on a picturesque, tree-lined block along the coveted Funston Corridor. A full-floor residence, it showcases elegant bay windows, rich hardwood floors, and a charming fireplace. The generous floor plan boasts 3 bedrooms, 1.5 baths including a remodeled full bath and comfortable family room. The formal dining room blends seamlessly with the sparkling modern kitchen. New counters, quality appliances, and in-unit laundry create the epitome of convenience. A verdant shared garden, and 1-car parking complete this spectacular offering. Just steps from renowned shops, fine dining, top schools, and effortless transportation, it presents a rare opportunity to own in one of San Francisco's most desirable neighborhoods.
